macros.name: textde
macros.doc: \textde renders its argument in denominator figures, no matter what the default figure style.

macros.name: textfrac
macros.doc: \textfrac renders its two arguments as a vulgar fraction, using \textnu for the numerator and \textde for the denominator.

macros.name: textfrac
macros.doc: \textfrac renders its two arguments as a vulgar fraction, using \textnu for the numerator and \textde for the denominator.

macros.name: textin
macros.doc: \textin renders its argument in inferior figures, no matter what the default figure style.

macros.name: textlf
macros.doc: \textlf and \texttlf render their arguments in proportional and tabular lining figures respectively, no matter what the default figure style.

macros.name: textnu
macros.doc: \textnu renders its argument in numerator figures, no matter what the default figure style.

macros.name: textosf
macros.doc: \textosf and \texttosf render their arguments in proportional and tabular oldstyle figures respectively, no matter what the default figure style.

macros.name: textsu
macros.doc: \textsu renders its argument in superior figures, no matter what the default figure style.

macros.name: texttlf
macros.doc: \textlf and \texttlf render their arguments in proportional and tabular lining figures respectively, no matter what the default figure style.

macros.name: texttosf
macros.doc: \textosf and \texttosf render their arguments in proportional and tabular oldstyle figures respectively, no matter what the default figure style.
